As of late December 2025, the AI landscape is dominated by a rapid succession of flagship releases, with **GLM-4.7**, **Grok 4.1**, **GPT-5.2**, and **Gemini 3** representing the state-of-the-art in reasoning, coding, and multimodal performance.[1][2][3]

### Model Performance and Rankings
The current frontier models are separated by specialized strengths rather than a single dominant leader. GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 currently lead in general reasoning and knowledge work, while GLM-4.7 and Grok 4.1 have carved out niches in open-source coding and emotional intelligence, respectively.[4][2][5]

| Feature | GLM-4.7 | Grok 4.1 | GPT-5.2 | Gemini 3 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Release Date** | Dec 22, 2025 [1] | Nov 17, 2025 [2] | Dec 11, 2025 [2] | Nov 18, 2025 [2] |
| **Key Strength** | Open-source SOTA coding [3] | Emotional Intelligence (EQ) [4] | Professional Knowledge Work [2] | Multimodality & Integration [5] |
| **Specialty** | Agentic workflows [6] | Real-time social data [4] | Agentic coding (SWE-Bench) [5] | Massive context & math [7] |
| **Accessibility** | Open-weight available [8] | X (formerly Twitter) Premium [9] | ChatGPT Plus / API [10] | Google Ecosystem / Vertex [2] |

### Specialized Capabilities
- **GLM-4.7 (Zhipu AI):** Released on December 22, 2025, it is positioned as a high-end open-weight foundation model. It specializes in agentic coding, meaning it can autonomously plan and execute multi-step development tasks, and it has set new state-of-the-art benchmarks for open-source models in reasoning and long-context analysis.[3][6][11][8]
- **Grok 4.1 (xAI):** Launched in mid-November, Grok 4.1 excels in "social intelligence," scoring significantly higher on EQ benchmarks like EQ-Bench3 than its competitors. It leverages real-time data from the X platform to provide up-to-the-minute insights, though it slightly trails Gemini and GPT in pure mathematical reasoning.[7][4]
- **GPT-5.2 (OpenAI):** Released as a "code red" response to Gemini 3, GPT-5.2 focuses on stability and speed for professional knowledge work. It remains a top-tier generalist with high marks in document analysis, complex PDF processing, and balanced agentic coding performance.[2][5][12][10]
- **Gemini 3 (Google):** Gemini 3 Pro is currently regarded as the leader for large-scale multimodal tasks and mathematical precision, scoring 95.0% on the AIME 2025 benchmark. Its primary advantage is its deep integration across Google's 2-billion-user ecosystem and its industry-leading context window size.[5][4][2][7]
